title: G01 evidence contract inside the gate: prd, acceptance-criteria, product-approval have semantics
objective: Give G01's three required evidence types deterministic semantics in validate_evidence -- PRD structure and three semantic rules, acceptance criteria shape, a human product-owner approval bound by digest to the exact PRD and not by its author -- so an instance reaching G01 / APPROVED means something.
business_value: With advance landed, G01 / APPROVED is reachable on evidence nobody opens. The first real gate must not be decorative.
in_scope: EVIDENCE_RULES in validate_evidence for the three types
templates/prd.json; skills/badf-prd (salvaged from PR #44 as references; registry entry)
tests failing-first; mutation per rule; compose
acceptance_criteria: examples/gate-dossier.G01.json renders APPROVED via the CLI
scope overlap, unknown metric_ref, placeholder -> refused naming the defect
acceptance criteria empty or duplicate ids -> refused
product-approval by non-human, by the PRD author, or with a stale prd_digest -> refused
each rule has a killed mutant

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch. Salvage credit: PR #44 (e3cfde1).
